description: This file defines an internal interface IPubSubRendezvousGrain for Pub-Sub rendezvous logic in Orleans streaming framework, including methods for managing producers and consumers, diagnostics, validation, and retrieving subscriptions.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer stream for a given stream ID and stream producer grain ID.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer stream for a given stream ID and stream producer grain ID.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer subscription with specified parameters.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer subscription specified by subscription ID and stream ID.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a given stream ID.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a given stream ID.

methods.name: DiagGetConsumers
methods.description: Returns an array of subscription states for consumers of a stream.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the rendezvous state.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtering by consumer.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Faults a specific subscription identified by its ID.
